verdict.rationale: Aider auto-commits every change with a descriptive message, letting developers review diffs via normal git tooling and use /undo or /git to inspect or roll back history; it also supports linting by default, /test and --auto-test for running test suites, and /run for executing code before accepting changes. This directly covers inspecting diffs and running checks pre-merge. Missing for 10: no built-in diff viewer/PR-style review UI (relies on external git tools) and no independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow specifically (one community comment notes users still bolt on separate review agents).
